topics.purpose: Generate the next derivable LABEL-FREE structural invariant of the genetic code that is NOT reducible to composition, beyond the exhausted edge-defect/embedding routes.
topics.question: Context (treat as established, do not relitigate): for the genetic code as a partition of the 64-codon Hamming cube Q6, the label-free fold-boundary structure (16-box first-two-position partition, amino-acid degeneracy classes, the 64->16->25->21 fold layers, the Ser/Leu/Arg 4-vs-2 branch splits, and the synonymous-fiber quotient equitability) ALL lie in / reduce to the registered composition control span C (GC by position, wobble class, codon-pair, degeneracy). The ONLY certified positive is the contravariant edge-hiding extremality of the functional e_in (within-block one-step edges), and an edge-exhaustion result shows the residual invariant battery is null once e_in is conditioned out. Both non-q6 Window6->codon embeddings fail (the Fibonacci-cube vertex set is not a code-structure outlier across all 17280 base/bit conventions; Gamma_6 is not graph-isomorphic to the codon family-adjacency graph). QUESTION: Propose the next LABEL-FREE structural invariant or functional of the codon graph + genetic-code partition that could carry forcing signal and is (a) NOT the e_in edge-hiding functional, (b) NOT reducible to composition -- i.e. it must plausibly SURVIVE a box/wobble-preserving (edge-profile-preserving) null, not merely a degeneracy-size-matched null, (c) defined without q6/Zeckendorf and without amino-acid property data (purely combinatorial/graph-structural), (d) testable by exact enumeration or a fixed-seed matched null on 64 codons. Give 2-3 concrete candidate routes; for EACH: the exact invariant, the exact projection/extremality test statistic, and the precise composition-controlled (box/wobble-preserving) null it must beat. If you believe no such non-reducible label-free invariant can exist, say so with the structural reason.
